author: zvon2000
body:
So what?

I've killed players that have ward 8x higher than my own HP

Also killed players who completely absorb or negate or ward off my most powerful charged up attack that does 50K+ to T9 raid bosses

Poison, blight, miasma, burn, rot... Etc.

None of these get blocked by ward, and they directly affect HP

(maybe throw in some sleep and blindness for extra flavour)

You can't imagine the joy of seeing someone's health bar just teetering a smidge near death, while their ward is at maximum and doing NOTHING to stop me!
